# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 35 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_035_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 35

**1** Jesus said: "One cannot enter the house of the strong [хом] person to take it by force [нопт] unless one binds [мор] their hands.

**2** Then one can ransack [ноует] their house."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *хом*: strength, power; the strong one
- *нопт*: to throw, cast — but here in the sense of taking/plundering
- *мор*: to bind, tie
- *ноует*: to plunder, ransack, turn upside down
- cf. Matt 12:29; Mark 3:27; Luke 11:21-22 — the Strong Man parable
- In the Synoptics this is explicitly about Jesus binding Satan; Thomas has no such allegorical frame
- The saying stands as a practical wisdom statement about the necessity of incapacitating before plundering
